mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the ceramic was most worthwhile: breaking, washing and leach-checking it explained how local material could become a safer, porous root medium.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the beds was straightforward and predictable, though it made the necessary progress clear.

surprise.text: The ceramic's leach check stood out as a useful precaution beyond simply washing away dust and sharp fines.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each visibly prepared, filled or watered the beds.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical explanations make me curious how the prepared beds will support crops, even though this chapter's choices were fairly straightforward.
